arguments.prompt:
Create a premium HAVENLINE sculpted 3D game-asset reference sheet. Match the supplied Havenline style reference: confident chunky silhouettes, broad clean bevels, subtly carved warm timber, convincing blue or dark steel, bronze fasteners where the source shows them, pale stone and selective clean snow on exposed ledges. Keep source-specific roof, canvas, glass and metal colors. Use refined animated-feature/PBR-like rendering, soft studio illumination, crisp useful detail, and quiet contact shadows. Use a pale warm-gray studio background, generous gutters and complete uncropped objects. Avoid photoreal grime, painterly noise, glossy toy-plastic flattening, extra characters, decorative piles, fake UI, promotional badges, and crowded copied-board graphics. This is deliberate production reference art with clear geometry and a small clean sans-serif heading.

REFERENCES IN ACTUAL ORDER
Reference 1: 18609.png — Original user mid-camp board; object identity and source-visible forms.
Reference 2: 18600.png — Original user unlabeled camp-prop board; object identity and source-visible forms.
Reference 3: fence-oblique-r2.png — Existing approved basic rope-bound fence identity; preserve it exactly in the supplemental corner assembly, separate from reinforced upgrades.
Reference 4: defense-platform-turnaround-r2.png — Reviewed Havenline material and rendering style ONLY: broad sculpted bevels, warm timber, blue steel, restrained snow, pale studio background. Do not copy the defense platform geometry.

SUBJECT: REINFORCED TIMBER PALISADES.
Render SHORT and TALL reinforced palisade modules from 18609 third row, using the blue steel straps and distinct post heights in that board; 18600 metal-banded palisade is supporting source. Keep the two upgrades distinct from the existing cream-rope basic fence. Add ONE supplemental assembly shown twice: a 90-degree corner using the EXACT approved basic rope-bound fence identity in reference 3, matching the corner arrangement visible at 18600 row 2 right. This corner is an additional view of an existing family, not a new wall tier. Show outside and inside so the corner-post relationship and rope joins read without interpenetration. Do not replace the base fence with blue bands.

SOURCE ANCHORS
- 18609.png: Reinforced palisade wall (short); third row
- 18609.png: Reinforced palisade wall (tall); third row
- 18600.png: metal-banded palisade; row2

SHEET
Small heading: HAVENLINE | REINFORCED TIMBER PALISADES. Requested landscape canvas 1536 × 1024, with detail large enough to judge. Six panels in a 3-column by 2-row landscape sheet. Columns: short reinforced module, tall reinforced module, existing basic-fence corner. Top row: front-left/front-left/outside. Bottom row: matching rear-right/rear-right/inside views.
Required panels:
- SHORT REINFORCED / FRONT-LEFT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- SHORT REINFORCED / REAR-RIGHT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- TALL REINFORCED / FRONT-LEFT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- TALL REINFORCED / REAR-RIGHT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- BASIC FENCE CORNER / OUTSIDE: Show the approved basic fence forming a coherent right-angle corner.
- BASIC FENCE CORNER / INSIDE: Reveal the same corner post, rope join and plank junction from inside.

The two opposing three-quarter views of a form must show ONE fixed design from front-left and rear-right; rotate the camera around it, do not mirror the image. Keep doors, windows, chimneys, pipe runs, roof pitch, support posts, snow patches, planks, handles, annexes and material assignments in the same physical positions. Preserve the distinct source silhouettes; do not make variants by recoloring one duplicated model. The source boards mostly show one side, so rear faces and any opened interiors are restrained concept interpretations. Add the short footer SOURCE-BASED CONCEPT · UNSEEN SURFACES INTERPRETED. Do not print invented levels, costs, capacities, rates, recipes, unlocks, dimensions or gameplay claims. Source-visible props remain aesthetic context; no new production chain, crop list, animal drop, weapon mechanism or runtime behavior is established.
